decisions.inventory: 1272 explicit cards across eleven complete collector families: full base and three full 300-card parallels; six named insert lists totaling 70; two unnumbered physical checklist cards. Every parallel is independently fetched from its own source namespace, not extrapolated from base.
decisions.tiers: Tier 1 #1–140 (regular players; historically 4–5 per pack), Tier 2 #141–240 (veteran stars; two per pack), Tier 3 #241–300 (superstars; one per pack). Preserve tier ranges as subset metadata across the base/parallel designs. Do not split one collector set into three VCS completion lists or imply every Tier 3 subject is a true RC. Uniform within-family availability flattens physical tier weighting under existing VCS convention.
decisions.rookies: Exactly three verified true base RCs: #80 Rafael Roque, #138 Doug Mientkiewicz, #218 Guillermo Garcia. All agree across base, separately fetched rookie index and BCP; indexed Beckett count also three. No inferred RCs on parallels/inserts or from tiers/Unleashed marketing.
decisions.namesTeams: Clean canonical subjects and actual historical team affiliations. Source teams agree across all four numbered families and with a supplementary full 300-row team listing. Will Clark #30 identifies Baltimore Orioles despite Texas Rangers uniform; preserve Baltimore and put uniform detail in base variant. Roger Clemens remains Toronto; Randy Johnson Arizona; David Wells New York Yankees.
decisions.numbering: Preserve parenthesized collector IDs such as 1 (U), 1 (WB), 1 (ID), 1 (H), 1 (TC), 1 (D). Assign stable NNO-A/NNO-B only to actual unnumbered checklist cards; printed ranges go in variant, clean player remains Checklist.
decisions.teams: All 1270 player-card rows have actual historical franchises. Only two generic checklists have blank teams; allowed by standard checklist-card exception. Team data COMPLETE, no invented MLB/League/Multiple affiliations and no pending-team override needed.
decisions.parallels: Rant purple foil, retail 1:2; Rave sparkling silver /150 and Super Rave sparkling gold /25, Hobby only. Original back scans confirm identifying markings and serial runs. No autograph/memorabilia/hologram family invented from foil design; no unrelated basketball or 1998 Circa Thunder rows.
decisions.pack: Hobby default: eight cards per pack, 36 packs per box, single series. Original Hobby wrapper/box and catalog descriptions agree. Retail box counts differ across descriptions; current TCDB says 20 while BCP says 36. Retail box also advertises five insert families and omits Hip-No-Tized despite BCP retail column; do not claim exact retail simulation.
decisions.odds: Use verified Hobby denominators only: Unleashed 6, batterz 18, In Depth 24, Hip-No-Tized 36, Turbo Charged 72, Dial 1 300. Rant null because retail-only in this Hobby model; Rave, Super Rave and Checklists null because exact insertion odds unverified. No invented rates from serial runs; no per-card odds text. Existing independent hit rolls replace base slots and do not reproduce physical positions/tier collation.
decisions.exclusions: Exclude Ben Grieve #247 Promotional Sample distributed to dealers/media; no pack-issued autograph or memorabilia issue verified. Beckett summary 301 vs numbered 300 does not justify an invented #301. Base #247 is retained as the actual regular Ben Grieve card. Printed N64/video-game sweepstakes packaging is not evidence of an additional trading-card checklist.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for pricing and image harvesting; pricing, images, unknown odds and pack QA pending before release. No production DB access or deployment.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Full #1–300 collector checklist. Keep historical Tier 1 #1–140, Tier 2 #141–240 and Tier 3 #241–300 within one base ProductSet; flatten availability per Set Factory convention.

productSets.name: Rant
productSets.notes: Full 300-card purple foil parallel, retail only at 1:2. Hobby default odds null; staged for pricing/images, not mixed into Hobby packs.

productSets.name: Rave
productSets.notes: Full 300-card sparkling silver foil parallel, all /150, Hobby only. No verified insertion denominator: null pending review.

productSets.name: Super Rave
productSets.notes: Full 300-card sparkling gold foil parallel, all /25, Hobby only. No verified insertion denominator: null pending review.

productSets.name: Hip-No-Tized
productSets.notes: Complete fifteen-card collector checklist; Hobby 1:36. Retail packaging omits this family despite BCP retail column; no definitive retail claim made.

productSets.name: Dial 1
productSets.notes: Complete ten-card die-cut plastic cellphone insert checklist; Hobby 1:300.

productSets.name: Checklists
productSets.notes: Two distinct unnumbered checklist cards #1–230 and #231–300 plus inserts. Local IDs NNO-A/NNO-B are VCS identifiers, not printed numbers. Both front/back scans verified. Randomly packed out, but exact denominator unverified: null.
